title: Review light on off render helper
objective: Review the new examples/flashlight/render_orbit_light_on_off.sh helper and README mention before local commit. Confirm it writes the expected light_on/light_off settings and invokes orbit render mode safely.
instructions: Confirm the helper writes exactly two settings: light_on enabled true intensity 30000.0 and light_off enabled false intensity 0.0, both yaw/pitch offsets 0.0.
Confirm it calls examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py --mode render with examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json and examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output.
Run focused non-simulator validation, including shell syntax and a dry invocation/wrapper check if practical.
definition_of_done: Inspector result clearly says whether Git-master can commit.
